card.name: Microsoft Windows API documentation pages
card.fires_on: Punctuation and layout words inside Microsoft Windows API reference pages, such as the InterlockedExchangeAdd page with its supported-version table and build date. It also fires on a few C++ library pages.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward Microsoft and Windows programming names such as Microsoft, PowerShell, Outlook and HRESULT.
